BUILT AROUND THE WAY YOU WORK

The booking is the first part of the experience.

Give guests the practical details before the doors open: when to arrive, where to go and what their reservation includes. Cowlendar lets you sell the date and the place together, with attendee questions and notifications built around the event.

Dates chosen by you

Offer only the dates and time slots that belong to the event. A one-off launch and a weekly tasting do not need the same availability schedule.

Places that match your capacity

Control the participants accepted per slot. Use participant categories when your offer has different guest types and prices.

Useful details before arrival

Collect booking questions for preparation, then include the meeting location and practical instructions in your customer communication.

A route back for your guests

Use booking data with Klaviyo to build follow-up or rebooking flows. Configure the beta integration and test the relevant events before activating messages.

FROM PRODUCT TO BOOKABLE SERVICE

A straightforward place to start.

  1. 01

    Publish the event offer

    Create the bookable service with its date, duration, meeting location and description. Explain what the ticket or reservation covers.

  2. 02

    Set the attendance rules

    Configure capacity, participant categories and required questions. Decide how cancellation and rescheduling should work for a date-specific event.

  3. 03

    Run through the guest journey

    Test a group purchase, the final available places and the confirmation. Make sure guests can find their date, venue and booking management details.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Events & experiences questions, answered.

Can I sell tickets for a specific event date?

You can sell reservations for specific dates and time slots using a bookable Shopify service. Confirm any separate requirements for ticket formats, scanning or assigned seating.

Can guests book as a group?

Yes. Configure group quantities, participant types and a per-slot capacity that reflects how many guests can attend.

Can I run the event online?

Yes. Configure a virtual meeting location. For Zoom group sessions, enable the shared-link setting so guests booking the same slot receive the same meeting link.

Can I follow up with guests afterward?

Yes. The Klaviyo beta integration documents booking-ended and follow-up events. Build and test your flow using the actual event data and your messaging preferences.
